highlights: Baseus AirJoy Series USB 3.0 Extension Cable 1.5m / USB Male to Female Cable
The extension cable allows you to transfer data at a speed of up to 5 Gbps in accordance with the USB 3.0 standard.
It has a USB-A (male) and USB-A (female) plug . It is backward compatible with USB 2.0 technology, so you can connect it to older devices equipped with the above. connectors.
With it, you can quickly copy data from an external hard drive, camera or camcorder with a USB-A connector.
The extension cable allows you to easily connect any device to a hard-to-reach USB port, which is located, for example, on the back of the computer case.
It will also solve the problem of too short cable from the external hard drive. Very useful in everyday office work.
